integrity: All displayed theorems are finite-dimensional claims with explicit definitions and a self-contained proof. Finite numerical and exact-rational checks are supplementary only.
scientific_limitations: Only steps 1 and 2, positive biases, finite cyclic groups. A repeated eigenvalue is not automatically a failure of stochastic scenery reconstruction. Full text of the 2006 same-walk comparator was not inspected.
title: Simple Fourier collisions and an exact temporal-moment determinant for two-step cyclic walks
